name: checkNumber
title: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a single finite or infinite number

origin.description: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a single finite or infinite number.
origin.usage: checkNumber(x, na.ok = FALSE, lower = -Inf, upper = Inf, finite = FALSE, null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: na.ok
arguments.text: When true, one missing value is allowed.

arguments.name: finite
arguments.text: When true, infinite values fail the check.

origin.details: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a single finite or infinite number.
origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
